apps.name: JadivCode IDE
apps.tagline: Editor, block builder and window designer for JadivCode
apps.description: A desktop editor for the JadivCode language: syntax colors, live checking with one-click fixes, a run console, a searchable help panel, a block editor for building programs with the mouse, and designers for windows and web pages. Install the JadivCode app first; the IDE uses its interpreter.
apps.author: JapySoft
